decisions.reason: Defining the HubSpot report as a simple sales funnel does not change which communication channels are visible on lead records.
The reporting format does not change the HubSpot Lead Status field or its MeetAlfred reply value.
A simple sales-funnel report does not necessarily alter how HubSpot lead lists are created or managed.
The report-format decision does not change the LinkedIn-to-Apollo-to-HubSpot transfer path or its timing.
The HubSpot sales-funnel report is independent of synchronizing HubSpot lists and leads to MeetAlfred.
Specifying a HubSpot report format does not change the required email integration between MeetAlfred and HubSpot.
The sales-funnel reporting decision does not alter the workflow for creating a MeetAlfred campaign and configuring its Zap.
The report-format decision does not resolve or change which LinkedIn URL is stored in the CRM.
A simple sales-funnel report does not affect how existing CRM records or duplicate prospects are indicated.
The reporting decision does not change recirculation of silent leads or export of follow-up lists to MeetAlfred.
The HubSpot reporting format does not change Apollo email enrichment or automatic delivery of enriched contacts.
The simple sales-funnel report does not change MeetAlfred account setup or subscription configuration.
